skill.name: skill-market-publisher
skill.description: Publish, submit, and verify local AI skills across public marketplaces. It prepares metadata, bundles, live adapters, manual workflows, and verification steps.
skill.summary: Prepare, package, publish, and verify AI skills across public marketplace registries.
skill.author: zjsxply

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, documentation URLs, placeholder examples, and disclosed marketplace metadata. Confirmed risks are the ClawHub subprocess paths and explicit network egress used for recon and live publication. No prompt injection evidence was found, but this community skill should require operator confirmation before external execution or submission.

remediation.issue: ClawHub command detection runs during bundle generation.
remediation.suggestion: Do not execute clawhub while building bundles or dry runs. Probe the CLI only inside publish --execute after explicit operator confirmation.

remediation.issue: External CLI execution resolves binaries from PATH by default.
remediation.suggestion: Require an absolute --clawhub-bin path or validate the resolved executable, then print the exact command before running it.

remediation.issue: Live submissions send skill content and contact metadata to third-party sites.
remediation.suggestion: Keep --execute mandatory, add a per-market consent prompt, and redact emails, wallet addresses, and tokens from logs and bundles unless required.

remediation.issue: Recon can fetch many external marketplace pages.
remediation.suggestion: Document network egress clearly, encourage market allowlists in examples, and cache or rate-limit recon results.

semantic_findings.title: External CLI Execution During Bundle Generation
semantic_findings.description: The bundle writer includes a ClawHub command payload builder that calls build_clawhub_command, which probes the local clawhub executable with subprocess.run. This can execute a PATH-resolved binary before an operator uses live publish.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The call chain from write_bundle to build_clawhub_command and detect_clawhub_publish_prefix is direct. The subprocess uses argument lists, but the local binary execution is real.

semantic_findings.title: External Publication Of Skill Content And Metadata
semantic_findings.description: Live adapters post repository URLs, skill descriptions, contact fields, seller metadata, and in one adapter the full SKILL.md content to third-party marketplaces. This is the stated purpose, but users need explicit consent before data leaves the machine.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The payload builders and submit functions clearly assemble local metadata and send it through post_json or post_form. The behavior is intentional but materially affects privacy and publication state.

content.value_statement: Publishing AI skills across many registries requires different metadata, URLs, and verification steps. This skill prepares bundles, checks market support, and runs supported submission adapters.
actual_capabilities: Inspects a local SKILL.md folder and detects repository layout.
Builds readiness plans for supported public skill markets.
Generates submission bundles with manifests, market plans, payloads, and manual notes.
Runs live adapters for verified HTTP and CLI targets when --execute is used.
Re-checks market pages for expected markers with the recon command.
Opens manual submission pages and prints per-site checklists.
limitations: It cannot bypass market login, seller onboarding, or human review.
Live submissions can publish metadata to third-party sites and need operator approval.
Market behavior changes often, so recon results can become stale.
Some targets remain manual, index-only, incompatible, or partially verified.

use_cases.title: Prepare a New Skill Release
use_cases.description: Inspect one skill folder, identify missing market fields, and produce a review-ready release plan.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Marketplace Submissions
use_cases.description: Generate payloads and manual notes for several public registries before an operator submits them.

use_cases.title: Verify Published Listings
use_cases.description: Check market-specific verification surfaces after submission to confirm public, pending, or blocked status.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect One Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this skill folder and tell me its repository layout, metadata, and obvious missing marketplace inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Market Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a market readiness plan for this skill using this repository URL and git ref. Highlight missing fields and manual targets.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Submission Bundle
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a submission bundle for this skill with payloads, manual notes, verification targets, and required market-only fields.

prompt_templates.title: Publish and Verify Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Dry-run the supported publish target, review the outgoing payload, execute only after approval, then verify the public listing status.

output_examples.input: A local skill folder and a GitHub repository URL.
output_examples.output: A readiness summary listing compatible markets, missing fields, layout warnings, and recommended next actions.

output_examples.input: A skill folder with author, version, category, and seller metadata.
output_examples.output: A submission bundle containing market-specific payload files, manual instructions, and verification targets.

output_examples.input: A completed live submission to a supported market.
output_examples.output: A verification result describing whether the listing is public, pending review, blocked, or needs follow-up.

best_practices: Run inspect and plan before creating any bundle or live submission.
Review every generated payload before using --execute for a live market.
Re-run recon before relying on a market adapter or public support claim.
anti_patterns: Do not submit fake data to learn a market validation path.
Do not claim automation for markets marked manual, index-only, incompatible, or needs-recon.
Do not store one-off submission IDs or dated run logs inside the reusable skill.

faq.question: Does this skill publish automatically?
faq.answer: Only supported targets can publish automatically, and live submission requires the --execute flag.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it support manual marketplaces?
faq.answer: Yes. It opens tracked submit pages and prints checklists when a stable automated path is unavailable.

faq.question: Can it verify that a listing is public?
faq.answer: It provides market-specific verification guidance and recon checks, but final listing status depends on each market.

faq.question: What data may leave my machine?
faq.answer: Live publish and recon can contact marketplace sites. Some submissions include skill content, repository URLs, email, or seller metadata.

faq.question: Should I use it for private skills?
faq.answer: No. This workflow is designed for public repositories and public marketplace listings.
